reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Birch Juice Moisturizing Sun Cushion 15g
reviews.text: Compact and easy to carry around version of Round Lab's excellent sunscreen. This version is a good portable option, and I prefer using this to Round Lab's sunscreen stick for my face, as it feels less sticky. It has a nice cooling effect- so good for summer. A little chalky appearance when first applied, but gets absorbed into the skin quickly, and skin feels moisturised. My reason for 4/5 stars is that I would really like to have a tinted version of this product, like the Round Lab tube tinted sunscreen.
reviews.zh: Round Lab 出色防曬嘅輕便版，方便攜帶。呢個版本好適合袋住出街，而且相比 Round Lab 嘅防曬棒，我更加鍾意用呢隻上面，因為冇咁黏笠。有唔錯嘅涼感——夏天用一流。剛搽上去會有少少白感，但好快就吸收，皮膚仲會覺得保濕。我俾 4/5 星嘅原因係我好想呢款出有色版，好似 Round Lab 支裝有色防曬咁。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Birch Juice Moisturizing Sun Cushion 15g
reviews.text: I wanted this product to be something I can put over makeup (even accepting the base might not survive). But this is really just normal sunscreen you tap in. I found it a bit hard to do so and ended up using my hands -which is not the point
reviews.zh: 我本來想搵一隻可以拍喺化妝上面嘅（就算會整花底妝都冇所謂）。但呢隻真係只係一般要拍入去嘅防曬。用上手覺得有啲難度，最後都係要用手——但咁就唔係用 cushion 嘅原意。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Birch Juice Moisturizing Sun Cushion 15g
reviews.text: It’s a mineral sunscreen so it will give you a white cask. I take it as a tone up sunscreen but it’s kind of difficult to make the whole face in even tone. So I ended up focus on the cheek bones and cheeks since I’ll only be out for a couple minutes. Overall, simple and easy apply on-the-go cushion.
reviews.zh: 佢係礦物防曬所以一定會泛白。當佢係提亮防曬咁用，但要全塊面搽到色調一致有啲難。所以我最後只集中搽顴骨同面頰，畢竟我只係出街一陣。整體嚟講，簡單又易用嘅出街 cushion。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Birch Juice Moisturizing Sun Cushion 15g
reviews.text: i don't know. i hoped this would feel more convenient, but a sun cushion just seems to be too tedious unless you're outside all day in a face of makeup. i can't tell if i'm applying enough coverage, but even then: i'm eastern european fair-light and it leaves a white cast on me.
reviews.zh: 我唔知點講。本來希望呢個會方便啲，但防曬氣墊用起上嚟真係太麻煩，除非你成日喺出面又已經化好妝。我都唔知自己上到嘅防曬夠唔夠多，但就算夠——我係東歐嘅偏白偏淺膚色，用完都會泛白。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Birch Juice Moisturizing Sun Cushion 15g
reviews.text: Me gusta es bloqueador en cushion para colocarlo antes del maquillaje, no deja sensación grasosa y se absorbe rápido, no queda blanquecina la piel. La esponjita me gusta mucho por la forma que tiene que permite colocarlo en diferentes zonas.
reviews.zh: 我鍾意呢款氣墊防曬，用喺化妝前。唔會有油笠感，吸收得好快，皮膚唔會泛白。粉撲我好鍾意，個形狀可以塗到唔同位置。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Birch Juice Moisturizing Sun Cushion 15g
reviews.text: This sun cushion is the second sunscreen from Round Lab that I’ve tried and it’s great as well! The packaging looks so cute! Just like the stick, this is also super convenient to apply, especially when you’re busy and in a hurry. I reapply every 3-4 hours and the cushion design makes the reapplication easy as well. This is lightweight, non sticky, makes my skin feel moisturized, and has a little scent to it – only if you smell it too close – but nothing like the usual SPF scent. Its color also makes my skin a little brighter, kind of like a tone up sunscreen, but blends well as long as you blend or pat it properly. Overall a great product and would buy again!
reviews.zh: 呢款防曬氣墊係我試過 Round Lab 第二款防曬，都一樣好用！包裝好得意！同防曬棒一樣，呢款都好方便搽，尤其係你趕時間嘅時候。我每 3-4 小時補搽一次，氣墊設計令補搽都好輕鬆。質地輕盈、唔黐笠，皮膚感覺保濕，帶少少香味——只係靠得太近先聞到——但同一般 SPF 嘅味道完全唔同。顏色仲會令皮膚提亮少少，類似調色防曬咁嘅效果，只要推開或者輕拍得當就會好貼服。整體嚟講係好好嘅產品，會再回購！

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Birch Juice Moisturizing Sun Cushion 15g
reviews.text: I did really like the concept of the cushion, however it left a really bad white cast on me. I have medium olive skin. I'm a shade 3 WO in Dior for skin shade reference. I wouldn't recommend for anyone with darker skin. If you are lighter or paler definitely try
reviews.zh: 氣墊嘅概念我真係好鍾意，但用喺我塊面泛白得好勁。我係中等橄欖膚色。Dior 嘅色號係 3 WO，畀大家做參考。膚色較深嘅人我唔會推薦。膚色較淺或者好白嘅人就可以試下。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Birch Juice Moisturizing Sun Cushion 15g
reviews.text: I really like this sunscreen, I love sunscreens that come in a cushion format because it makes reapplication so easy. This sunscreen has a slight white cast but that's expected since it's a mineral sunscreen, however shortly after application it melts into your skin and you hardly notice a white cast. (I have very fair skin so take this with a grain of salt if you have a dark complexion) The product comes out of the cushion easily without too much pressure. I love the size and shape of the applicator too, I have tried other cushion products with this style applicator and usually they're too big, but this one is perfect with a nice pointed tip for getting in tighter areas around the eyes and nose. Would probably buy again.
reviews.zh: 我真係好鍾意呢款防曬，鍾意氣墊設計嘅防曬因為補搽真係好方便。呢款有少少泛白，但因為係礦物防曬所以係預期之內，搽完一陣之後就會融入皮膚，泛白幾乎睇唔到。（我膚色好白，深色肌嘅朋友要自行斟酌）輕輕按氣墊就容易取到產品。粉撲嘅大小同形狀我都好鍾意，我試過其他同類形嘅氣墊粉撲通常都太大，但呢個剛剛好，尖頭設計方便搽到眼周同鼻翼呢啲細位。可能會再回購。
